user.title: NESO Demand Flexibility Service
user.description: Enter a UK postcode to find your DFS zone. Leave it blank to use the Home Assistant location.

participant.title: Track participants (optional)
participant.description: Pick any registered DFS participants bidding in zone Z{zone} to follow, or leave it empty. Each one gets its own entities, scoped to this zone. Confirmed results are reported separately from the historical accept rate, which only applies while an auction is unsettled. You can change this later.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach NESO or the postcode lookup service.
error.outside_gb: That location is not inside any DFS zone. The service covers Great Britain only.

abort.already_configured: This DFS zone is already configured.

init.description: Pick any registered DFS participants to track in this zone. Each one gets its own set of entities. Confirmed results are reported separately from the historical accept rate, which only applies while an auction is unsettled.
